name: Uesugi Yayoi
source:
A career woman and the main character's boss from his office days, she projects a cool and confident image. She has a complex regarding her large chest and the unwanted attention it brings, though. Her hobbies include listening to relaxing music, and skin care (as she is acutely worried about getting older).

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/bazooka-cafe.html]JAST USA[/url]]
